text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend eleven candidates, including one as Chair, for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee: HRA2-2 HRA2-5 HRA2-9 HRA2-21 HRA2-29 HRA2-40 HRA2-47 HRA2-50 HRA2-61 HRA2-64 HRA2-69 HRA2-87 HRA2-88 HRA2-91 HRA2-92 HRA2-93 HRA2-96 HRA2-102 HRA2-103 HRA2-107 HRA2-108 HRA2-112 HRA2-115 HRA2-116 HRA2-134 HRA2-139 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 30, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals currently appointed or being considered for appointment to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee.
